extensionDescription.message: Recognizes anime on any site, shows taste match, marks watching status, and keeps local viewing statistics.

privacyDisclosureLocalRead.message: On sites you allow, the extension locally reads the anime title, episode, and video player state.

privacyDisclosureMatch.message: A cleaned title is sent to AniReko to find a catalog match. The full page address is not sent.

privacyDisclosureSync.message: Status, episode, position, and voice track are sent only after you enable account sync.

privacyDisclosureReport.message: If anime is not recognized, a separate button sends only the hostname and technical structure—without the address, page title, cookies, or history.

diagnosticsConsent.message: Send anonymous diagnostics for unsupported players (hostname and structure, without path/query)

reportAnimeMiss.message: There is anime here — report it

reportAnimeMissDetail.message: Only the hostname and technical page structure will be sent—without the address, page title, cookies, or history.

localHistoryHint.message: Viewing history is stored locally. For recognition, AniReko receives a cleaned title, not the full page address.

syncDescription.message: Sync with AniReko: watching status and episode progress (episode, position, voice track)

confirmDeleteLocalData.message: Delete local history, caches, settings, and account binding? Data in your AniReko account will not be deleted.

syncPausedBoundAccount.message: Sync is paused: the extension is bound to $BOUND$. Turn on the switch to explicitly rebind it to “$CURRENT$”.

syncNotBound.message: Sync is not bound yet. Turn on the switch to allow writing to this account.

authorizationViaSite.message: Sign in through the AniReko website

loginRequiredTitle.message: Sign in at anireko.com first—the extension uses the same session

loginRequiredSyncTitle.message: Sign in at anireko.com to sync progress

animeNotFoundDetail.message: The title could not be identified on this page

reloadBeforeReport.message: Reload the page after installing the extension, then you can send a report.

reportAlreadySending.message: A report is already being sent…

waitForCurrentReport.message: Wait for the current report to finish.

reportDuplicateDetail.message: The developer already has a report from this site.

reportSuccessDetail.message: The developer will receive an anonymous technical report.

reportFailedDetail.message: The report could not be sent. Check your connection and try again.

syncOffUntilConsent.message: Sync is off until you give consent

metadataTitleMissing.message: No title was extracted from page metadata

checkingHtml5Frames.message: Checking HTML5 video in all available frames

loginForMatch.message: sign in on the website to see your match %

animeFoundPlayVideo.message: Anime found. Start the video to complete the player check.

openAnimeWithPlayer.message: Open an anime page with a video player.
